AUTHOR: Amalia
TITLE: EdgeFishCam: An Edge AI-based Fish Detection Through YOLO and Image Enhancement Techniques
VENUE: 2026 ASU International Conference in Emerging Technologies for Sustainability and Intelligent Systems (ICETSIS)
REGION: DeepFish (tropical Australia); Sabang, Aceh, Indonesia (local dataset)
DATA: DeepFish (6,517 images, 15,463 boxes; 909 test images); local Sabang dataset (3,111 frames extracted from underwater videos)
V_EV: Sec. III.A: DeepFish annotations 'including challenging visibility conditions'; Table II: 'AVERAGE LOE, UIQM, AND UCIQE' on a 10% DeepFish subset (enhancement only)
D2: DeepFish: 909 test images (from prior work); local: 70/15/15 (2,178/466/467)
D_EV: Sec. III.A (p.2): local Sabang 'dataset built from underwater videos via frame extraction ... split into 70/15/15'; Conclusion (p.6): 'use video/location-based splits to avoid leakage' (frame-level split, leakage acknowledged)
R_EV: Sec. IV.A.4: 'In L-pre, performance dropped dramatically (mAP@0.5 6.07%)' vs DeepFish in-domain 'mAP@0.5 = 96.15%'
C_EV: Sec. IV.A.3: 'Evaluation used a confidence threshold of 0.25 and an IoU threshold of 0.5.'
E_EV: Sec. III.F: 'evaluated using standard detection metrics (mAP@0.5, Precision, Recall, F1-score, and IoU)'
ARCH: YOLOv3 with CLAHE + percentile blending pre-processing; Jetson Orin Nano deployment
METR: mAP@0.5, precision, recall, F1, mean IoU, TP/FP/FN; UIQM/UCIQE/LOE for enhancement
NOTE: Two designs: DeepFish in-domain (split from prior work [17], unit not stated) and local Sabang fine-tuning (frames extracted from videos, 70/15/15 with no grouping). Coded the local split (final adapted results); leakage acknowledged only as future work ('video/location-based splits to avoid leakage') -> D4=Y, D_ALL=P. External: DeepFish-trained model tested directly on Sabang (L-pre) with numeric drop -> R_ALL Y. UIQM/UCIQE used only to choose enhancement, not to stratify detection performance. Sabang camera platform/habitat not described.
AUTHORS_FULL: N. A. Amalia; K. Muchtar; H. Sofyan; H. Riza; M. Subianto; M. Fitria
